legend: A flowerbed has many flowers and two fountains.

You can adjust the water pressure and set any values r1(r1 ≥ 0) and r2(r2 ≥ 0), giving the distances at which the water is spread from the first and second fountain respectively. You have to set such r1 and r2 that all the flowers are watered, that is, for each flower, the distance between the flower and the first fountain doesn't exceed r1, or the distance to the second fountain doesn't exceed r2. It's OK if some flowers are watered by both fountains.
You need to decrease the amount of water you need, that is set such r1 and r2 that all the flowers are watered and the r12 + r22 is minimum possible. Find this minimum value.
input: The first line of the input contains integers n, x1, y1, x2, y2 (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000,  - 107 ≤ x1, y1, x2, y2 ≤ 107) — the number of flowers, the coordinates of the first and the second fountain.
Next follow n lines. The i-th of these lines contains integers xi and yi ( - 107 ≤ xi, yi ≤ 107) — the coordinates of the i-th flower.
It is guaranteed that all n + 2 points in the input are distinct.
output: Print the minimum possible value r12 + r22. Note, that in this problem optimal answer is always integer.
note: The first sample is (r12 = 5, r22 = 1): ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b22bc3b9d5e08270abeb227926f71a59c047471e.png) The second sample is (r12 = 1, r22 = 32): ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/52cff766dc5ed8406cad96178771df70a1edc042.png)

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含整数 n、x1、y1、x2、y2（1 ≤ n ≤ 2000，−10^7 ≤ x1、y1、x2、y2 ≤ 10^7）——花朵的数量，以及第一个和第二个喷泉的坐标。
接下来是 n 行。其中第 i 行包含整数 xi 和 yi（−10^7 ≤ xi、yi ≤ 10^7）——第 i 朵花的坐标。
保证输入中的全部 n + 2 个点互不相同。

output.ai: 输出 r₁² + r₂² 的可能的最小值。注意，在本题中最优答案总是整数。

note.ai: 第一个样例为(r₁² = 5，r₂² = 1)：![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b22bc3b9d5e08270abeb227926f71a59c047471e.png) 第二个样例为(r₁² = 1，r₂² = 32)：![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/52cff766dc5ed8406cad96178771df70a1edc042.png)

legend.ai: 一个花坛里有许多花，还有两个喷泉。
你可以调节水压，并将任意值 r1(r1 ≥ 0) 和 r2(r2 ≥ 0) 分别设置为水从第一个和第二个喷泉喷洒到的距离。你需要设置这样的 r1 和 r2，使所有的花都能被浇到，也就是说，对于每朵花，它到第一个喷泉的距离不超过 r1，或者到第二个喷泉的距离不超过 r2。某些花同时被两个喷泉浇到也是可以的。
你需要减少所需的水量，也就是设置这样的 r1 和 r2，使所有的花都能被浇到，并且 r12 + r22 尽可能小。求这个最小值。
